lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular white spots arranged in roughly parallel vertical columns posterior to the five gill slits; a specific high-luminance node is highlighted by a light-blue arrow at the dorsal-most position of the column immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the columns of circular blobs to create a grid-like lattice across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Prominent horizontal linear features run across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small semicircular notches are visible on the trailing edge of the pectoral fin (indicated by arrow). A distinctive irregular loop or 'U-shaped' pattern interruption is present on the mid-lateral flank (indicated by arrow).
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin surface displays a pattern of white spots surrounded by faint concentric rings of varying luminance.
